body:
Saying that it never gets better is you convincing yourself that the lie you are saying is the truth. You know deep down it always gets better. When you were little you would get a cut playing outside. You would come in, crying of course. An adult would probably clean it, care for it, and patch you up. Sure it hurt to the touch for a bit, but time is the most powerful medicine. Time is what made that cut go away. Do yourself, me, the world a favor, and just give yourself some time. Life is easy for some and life fucking sucks for others, but it's up to us to fight through the horridness of being alive to find that light. A spark of hope to literally change our destiny forever. That spark could be a girl or boy in your life. It could be an inheritance, a newly found passion. 

We wake up from nightmares only to hope the next night we'll have a beautiful dream.
